Unified functional enrichment for glycoproteomics

enrich_glyco.Rd

Runs protein-centric or glycan-trait-centric over-representation analysis (ORA) or gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) through one entry point.

Protein-centric enrichment analyzes proteins with dysregulated glycosylation. Glycan-trait-centric enrichment analyzes protein sets or protein rankings stratified by a glycan trait; it does not directly enrich glycan structures.

Usage

enrich_glyco(
  dea_res,
  method = c("ora", "gsea"),
  database = c("GO", "KEGG", "Reactome", "WikiPathways", "DO", "NCG"),
  scope = c("protein", "glycan_trait"),
  dea_p_cutoff = 0.05,
  dea_log2fc_cutoff = c(-1, 1),
  rank_by = "signed_log10p",
  aggr = "median",
  orgdb = NULL,
  ont = NULL,
  organism = NULL,
  universe = NULL,
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  p_cutoff = 0.05,
  q_cutoff = 0.2,
  min_gs_size = 10,
  max_gs_size = 500,
  exponent = 1,
  eps = 1e-10,
  seed = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

dea_res

Differential analysis result. It can be a supported glystats result or a data frame accepted by the selected existing enrich_*() family.

method

Enrichment method: "ora" or "gsea".

database

Annotation database: "GO", "KEGG", "Reactome", "WikiPathways", "DO", or "NCG".

scope

Analysis scope: "protein" for protein-centric enrichment or "glycan_trait" for glycan-trait-centric enrichment.

dea_p_cutoff

P-value cutoff used to select proteins for ORA.

dea_log2fc_cutoff

Log2 fold-change cutoffs used to select proteins for ORA. The value must contain a negative and a positive boundary.

rank_by

Ranking criterion used for GSEA. See enrich_gsea_go().

aggr

Aggregation method used to combine scores for the same protein in GSEA. See enrich_gsea_go().

orgdb

An OrgDb object or its package name. It defaults to "org.Hs.eg.db" for GO and NCG.

ont

Ontology used by GO or DO. It defaults to "MF" for GO and "HDO" for DO.

organism

Organism passed to the selected database. Defaults are "hsa" for KEGG and DO, "human" for Reactome, and "Homo sapiens" for WikiPathways.

universe

Background proteins for ORA.

p_adj_method

P-value adjustment method passed to the enrichment backend.

p_cutoff

P-value cutoff passed to the enrichment backend.

q_cutoff

Q-value cutoff passed to the enrichment backend for ORA.

min_gs_size

Minimum gene-set size.

max_gs_size

Maximum gene-set size.

exponent

GSEA weighting exponent.

eps

Epsilon used for GSEA p-value calculation.

seed

Whether to set a random seed in GSEA.

...

Additional arguments passed to the selected enrichment backend.

Value

A clusterProfiler enrichment result. ORA returns an enrichResult or compareClusterResult, and GSEA returns a gseaResult or compareClusterResult.

See also

enrich_ora_go(), enrich_gsea_go(), enrich_gc_ora_go(), enrich_gc_gsea_go()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
enrich_glyco(dea_res, method = "ora", database = "GO")
enrich_glyco(
  dea_res,
  method = "gsea",
  database = "Reactome",
  scope = "glycan_trait"
)
} # }
